subject: Advisory: 3 cross-exam question similarities flagged (non-blocking)
body:
GR,

FYI advisory from cross-exam dedup analysis. These are NOT CI blockers (GD confirmed advisory mode). Sharing for awareness in case you want to rotate values:

1. rp6-q3 vs rp5-q1 -- structurally similar question
2. rp6-q7 vs rp1-q6 -- structurally similar question
3. rp7-q2 vs rp1-q2 -- structurally similar question

GD rationale: Kai uses these exams sequentially across study days. Cross-session structural similarity is not meaningful memorization risk (unlike same-exam answer pattern overlap). If you want to rotate the parameter values for variety, go ahead -- but no action required.

The CI gate (tests/cross-exam-verify.js) is set to advisory mode and will not block on these.

- GF
